```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load required libraries
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(DescTools)
```

## Data Import & Cleaning

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load rental datasets
brooklyn_one_bed <- read_csv('brooklyn-one-bed.csv')
brooklyn_price <- brooklyn_one_bed$rent

manhattan_one_bed <- read_csv('manhattan-one-bed.csv')
manhattan_price <- manhattan_one_bed$rent

queens_one_bed <- read_csv('queens-one-bed.csv')
queens_price <- queens_one_bed$rent
```

---

## 1. Calculate Mean Rents

```{r}
# Calculate mean prices across all three boroughs
brooklyn_mean <- mean(brooklyn_price, na.rm = TRUE)
manhattan_mean <- mean(manhattan_price, na.rm = TRUE)
queens_mean <- mean(queens_price, na.rm = TRUE)

print(paste("Brooklyn Mean:", round(brooklyn_mean, 2)))
print(paste("Manhattan Mean:", round(manhattan_mean, 2)))
print(paste("Queens Mean:", round(queens_mean, 2)))
```

---

## 2. Calculate Median Rents

```{r}
# Calculate median prices across all three boroughs
brooklyn_median <- median(brooklyn_price, na.rm = TRUE)
manhattan_median <- median(manhattan_price, na.rm = TRUE)
queens_median <- median(queens_price, na.rm = TRUE)

print(paste("Brooklyn Median:", brooklyn_median))
print(paste("Manhattan Median:", manhattan_median))
print(paste("Queens Median:", queens_median))
```

---

## 3. Calculate Mode Rents

```{r}
# Calculate statistical mode using DescTools::Mode()
# Extracting the first modal value in case of multimodal distributions
brooklyn_mode <- Mode(brooklyn_price, na.rm = TRUE)[1]
manhattan_mode <- Mode(manhattan_price, na.rm = TRUE)[1]
queens_mode <- Mode(queens_price, na.rm = TRUE)[1]

print(paste("Brooklyn Mode:", brooklyn_mode))
print(paste("Manhattan Mode:", manhattan_mode))
print(paste("Queens Mode:", queens_mode))
```

---

## 4. Consolidated Analysis & Verification

```{r}
# Mean Print Checks
```

## 5. Summary Table Construction

```{r}
# Create comprehensive comparison table
rent_summary <- tibble(
  Borough = c("Manhattan", "Brooklyn", "Queens"),
  Mean = c(round(manhattan_mean, 2), round(brooklyn_mean, 2), round(queens_mean, 2)),
  Median = c(manhattan_median, brooklyn_median, queens_median),
  Mode = c(manhattan_mode, brooklyn_mode, queens_mode),
  Skewness_Premium = Mean - Median
)

rent_summary
```
